notes.title: Infinity Project: PATTERNS release date now live!
notes.notes:
It's official! Infinity Project: PATTERNS, the indie, urban-fantasy RPG will be coming out on August 3rd, 2022!

Message from the solo-developer of the project, the artist NEnd:

Hey everyone! I can't believe it's finally here! Infinity Project is a series I've been working on as far back as 2007. This first installment of the series has been in concept since 2011, first being published as a single chapter webcomic that gave people a glimpse into what "PATTERNS" could be.

Well, now you can finally experience the whole story of "PATTERNS"! There's a lot of serious and wild characters in here, I hope you find one might connect with and like! As for me, I'm a big fan of the blue-baseball-capped Miyoshi Sato (you'll be seeing a lot of art of her). 

I'll be posting new artwork and insights into the creation of the "Infinity Project" Story over the next few weeks until the game releases at midnight PDT August 3rd 2022, which is when I'll be streaming a launch party over at www.twitch.tv/nendtv with all sorts of festivities going on (Including live drawing from me!). 

Don't miss it!
